title: npm install fails with ERESOLVE when adding firebase-admin 14 to a Cloud Functions project
symptoms: ERESOLVE unable to resolve dependency tree
Could not resolve dependency: peer firebase-admin@"^11.10.0 || ^12.0.0 || ^13.0.0" from firebase-functions@7.2.5
firebase deploy predeploy npm ci step fails after bumping firebase-admin
cause: firebase-functions declares the firebase-admin majors it supports as a peer range, and that range lagged the firebase-admin 14 release by about six weeks.
fix: Upgrade firebase-functions to 7.3.0 or later together with firebase-admin 14. Avoid legacy-peer-deps as a permanent fix.
apply:
npm install firebase-functions@^7.3.0 firebase-admin@^14
# functions/package.json engines must also be node 22 or later for firebase-admin 14
affected: firebase-functions 7.2.x and earlier with firebase-admin 14.x; fixed in firebase-functions 7.3.0 (July 2026)
